mentions.name: Demotape
mentions.description: A screen recording app for macOS (with a skill for Kiro or Claude Code) that inspects your project, plans the scenes, operates the browser, records the demo, and adds synchronized narration and captions using OpenAI, ElevenLabs, or a model run locally with Docker.
mentions.audience: Creating polished demo videos to showcase apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I created [Demotape] a screen recording app for MacOs (with an skill for Kiro or Claude Code) so it can inspect your project, plan the scenes, operate the browser, record the demo, and add synchronized narration and captions(w/ OpeanAI, ElevenLabs or run your model locally with docker).
